title: Item Age on HostCover Pet-Damage Claims: Questions and Answers
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) pet damage.** The pet depreciation share follows the plan level and the age in whole months the claim records for the items the pet damaged: on a level whose items are paid at depreciated value, items 61 months old or older are depreciated by 60 percent, items 37 to 60 months old by 40 percent and items 13 to 36 months old by 20 percent; items 12 months old or younger, and items on a level whose items are not paid at depreciated value, are not depreciated. The percentage is taken off the verified pet-damage loss, and the guest payments and the deductible are subtracted from the depreciated pet-damage loss.

**Which levels pay pet-damaged items at depreciated value?** HostCover Essential, HostCover Standard, HostCover Plus and HostCover Premier. HostCover Elite and HostCover Estate do not, so nothing is depreciated on those levels.

**Where is the age taken from?** From the age in whole months the pet-damage claim records for the damaged items.

**What does each age band take off, on a depreciating level?**

| Age | Taken off the verified pet-damage loss |
|---|---|
| up to 12 months | nothing |
| 13 to 36 months | 20 percent |
| 37 to 60 months | 40 percent |
| 61 months or older | 60 percent |

**A dog chewed a rug recorded as 36 months old; verified loss 900.00 on HostCover Plus. What remains after depreciation?** 720.00: 20 percent is taken off. At 37 months it would be 540.00. (Hypothetical claim.)

**The same rug on HostCover Estate?** 900.00; Estate does not depreciate.

**An armchair recorded as 12 months old on HostCover Essential?** Not depreciated.
